info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.
info.title: Crawlora API

get.description: Returns the analyst articles Google Finance shows for a quote such as `AAPL:NASDAQ`. Each article has its title, source, URL, publication time (ISO and Unix), thumbnail and the related instruments with price, change and exchange. Articles come back only when Google Finance has them for that quote.

Returns the price chart for a Google Finance quote such as `AAPL:NASDAQ` or `BTC-USD` over a window from `1d` to `max` (default `1d`). Each point has a time, price and volume; the response also carries the instrument's name, exchange, currency, current price, change and previous close.

Returns the category labels Google Finance assigns to a quote such as `AAPL:NASDAQ`, for example Technology, in `categories`. The response also carries the instrument itself: ticker, exchange, name, current price, change, previous close, currency and after-hours data.

Returns Google Finance company details for a quote such as `AAPL:NASDAQ`: description, CEO, employee count, headquarters, sector, market capitalisation, P/E ratio, open, day high and low, 52-week high and low, and volume.

Searches Google Finance for instruments matching a company name or ticker query and returns results with ticker, exchange, name, price, currency, and change data. Use a returned ticker with quote, company, chart, or news endpoints.
get.summary: Find Google Finance instruments by query

get.description: Returns the financial statements Google Finance holds for a quote such as `AAPL:NASDAQ`, as `annual` and `quarterly` rows plus a `currency`. Each row has revenue, net income, EBITDA, EPS, margins, cash flow, assets, liabilities and equity. The rows are empty when Google Finance has no statement data for the quote.

Returns Google Finance news for one market category, identified by the `category` path id. Use `offset` to page through results. Each item has its title, URL and publication time (ISO and Unix), plus the source, a thumbnail and any related quotes with price, change and percent change when Google provides them. The response also echoes `category` and `offset`.

Lists the instruments in one Google Finance market category, chosen by the required `category` id and paged with `offset`. Each item has its ticker, exchange, name, price, change and change percent, previous close, currency, country and after-hours data.

Returns the Google Finance earnings calendar. Each item has the company name, fiscal period, event time (including a Unix timestamp), conference call phone and URL when listed, and the instrument with its ticker, exchange, price and change.

Returns the stocks Google Finance features on its markets page. Each instrument has its ticker, exchange, name, price, change and change percent, previous close, currency, country, time zone and after-hours data.

Returns the top headline on Google Finance markets as one article: title, source, URL, publication time (ISO and Unix), thumbnail and the related instruments with price and change. The article is present only when Google Finance shows a headline.

Returns the market indices Google Finance lists, such as the Dow Jones Industrial Average. Each index has its ticker, exchange, name, current value, change and change percent, previous close and last update time.

Lists Google Finance market movers. `categories` takes comma-separated numeric categories, `count` sets how many items to return (default 20) and `offset` skips ahead. Each item has its ticker, exchange, name, price, change and change percent, and previous close.

Lists the top Google Finance instruments for a ranking metric. `metric` is a Google Finance metric id (default 6) and `page` is the page number (default 1). Each item has its ticker, exchange, name, price, change and change percent, and previous close.
get.summary: Google Finance top stocks by metric

get.description: Returns the instruments currently trending on Google Finance, up to `limit` items (default 18). Each has its ticker, exchange, name, price, change and change percent, previous close, currency and after-hours data.

Returns recent Google Finance news for one quote, such as `AAPL:NASDAQ`, given in the `quote` path parameter. `limit` caps the number of articles and defaults to 6. Each article has its title, source, URL, publication time (ISO and Unix), thumbnail, and related quotes with price and change data.

Returns the Google Finance quote page for a symbol such as `AAPL:NASDAQ` or `BTC-USD`. The response carries key stats, an about section (CEO, employees, founded, headquarters, website), news, and investment tables for the income statement, balance sheet and cash flow by quarter and year.

parameters.description: Stock symbol to fetch the latest quote for (e.g., AAPL:NASDAQ, BTC-USD)
parameters.name: quote

get.description: Returns the instruments Google Finance lists as related to a quote such as `AAPL:NASDAQ`. The response gives the queried `instrument` and an `items` list, each with ticker, exchange, name, price, change and change percent, and previous close.
Searches Google Finance for instruments matching `q`, such as a company name. Each match has its ticker, exchange, company name, currency, price, change and percentage change.

Returns the price series Google Finance charts for a ticker such as `AAPL:NASDAQ` or `BTC-USD`. `window` sets the range: `1d` (default), `5d`, `1m`, `6m`, `ytd`, `1y`, `5y` or `max`. Each point has a `time`, `price` and `volume`.

parameters.description: Ticker symbol to fetch data for example:AAPL:NASDAQ, BTC-USD
parameters.name: ticker

parameters.description: Time window for the ticker data (default: 1d), options: 1d, 5d, 1m, 6m, 1y, 5y, max
parameters.name: window

post.description: Searches Google Jobs for the `query` in the request body, optionally narrowed by `location` and paged with `page`. Each result has the job title, company, location, employment type, posting time, snippet, source and URL. The response echoes the query, location and page.

get.description: Returns the Google Maps details of one place by its Google `place_id`: name, categories, address, coordinates, phone, website, description, image, amenities, rating and review count. `rating` is `null` when the place has no aggregate rating on Google.

X-RateLimit-Per-Second-Remaining.description: Number of remaining requests per second

get.description:
Returns the photos Google publishes for a specified place_id — the imagery shown on
the place's Google Maps page, typically dozens of images for a well-covered business.
Each entry carries the image URL as served plus its pixel dimensions when reported;
swap the trailing size suffix on the URL (e.g. `=w203-h100-k-no`) to request other
dimensions. Contributor avatars and review-attached photos are excluded. This is the
place page's image set, not a paginated archive feed. Rate limit is enforced at 1
request per second.

parameters.description: Maximum number of photos to return. Omit or 0 for all captured.
parameters.name: limit

X-RateLimit-Per-Second-Remaining.description: Number of remaining requests per second

get.description:
Returns the reviews Google shows on a specified place_id's Google Maps page —
typically the 8 most relevant, each with its rating, text, reviewer, timestamp, and
any photos the reviewer attached. Photo-only reviews return an empty `text`.
This is the place page's first page of reviews, not the full review archive.
Rate limit is enforced at 1 request per second.

parameters.description: Maximum number of reviews to return. Omit or 0 for all captured.
parameters.name: limit

X-RateLimit-Per-Second-Remaining.description: Number of remaining requests per second

post.description: Searches Google Maps with a request body of `keyword`, `language` and `country` (an ISO-2 code such as `us`), all required. Each place has its name, place id, categories, address, coordinates, phone, website, rating and review count. `rating` is `null` when Google has no aggregate rating.

X-RateLimit-Per-Second-Remaining.description: Number of remaining requests per second

get.description: Returns current Google News search results. Pages slice the finite result snapshot; they do not traverse the Google Search index. Results include title, source, publisher article URL, age, and thumbnail when available. Valid no-results searches and exhausted pages return an empty array. Locale defaults to country=us and lang=en. Returns 503 for blocked or malformed upstream responses.

Returns only the interest-by-region widget from the Google Trends Explore widget flow. Supports multiple comparison terms and returns an empty interest_by_region array when Google returns no rows.

Returns Google Trends interest over time for 1 to 5 `keywords`. Optional inputs are `geo` (default worldwide), `time_range` (default `today 12-m`), `hl`, `tz`, `category` and `type` (`web`, `image`, `news`, `youtube` or `shopping`). Each time point carries a value per keyword, with a `has_data` flag.
Returns only the related topics widget from the Google Trends Explore widget flow. Returns an empty related_topics array when Google returns no topic rows for the requested term/filter combination.
Returns the Rising related queries widget for one or more Google Trends explore terms. Returns an empty queries array when Google returns no rows for the requested term/filter combination.
Returns the Top related queries widget for one or more Google Trends explore terms. Returns an empty queries array when Google returns no rows for the requested term/filter combination.

get.description: Returns the list of location codes that Google Trends supports, such as `US`, `HK` and `GB`, in `locations`. The Explore endpoints also accept `WORLDWIDE`, which appears in the list. It takes no parameters.

Returns Google Trends Trending Now for a country or territory (`geo`, default `US`): each trend's query, rank, search traffic, status, start and update time, related terms and news articles, with explore and share links. Filter by time window, category and status, and choose the sort order.

post.description: Returns the Explore detail widgets for a single trending term, including interest over time, regional interest, top/rising related queries, and related topics when Google returns them.

get.description: Returns Google video vertical results (title, platform, link, duration, age). Locale defaults to country=us and lang=en. Returns 503 when Google serves a challenge page or an unusable response.

parameters.description: Results per page; defaults to 10, clamped to 1..50
parameters.name: count

parameters.description: Two-letter country code; defaults to us
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: Google UI language; defaults to en
parameters.name: lang
